name: Downtown Disney Wetzel's Pretzels Original Soft Pretzel or Wetzel Bitz (Unbuttered / Light Salt)
brandOrRestaurant: Wetzel's Pretzels (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Freshly kneaded and baked on-site from simple white wheat flour, yeast, water, and salt—asking for "no butter" makes it 100% dairy-free, nearly fat-free, and 9.0/10 flare-safe.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Original Wetzel Bitz or a Original Pretzel with **"No Butter"** (or light butter if tolerated) and skip the jalapeño cheese dip.
watchOuts: Skip Jalapeño Bitz, Pepperoni Twist, and frozen lemonades (citrus trigger)
